integrity: All-dimensional claims use the analytical two-coset reduction, odd monotonicity and cubic Taylor argument; numerical checks do not certify infinite parameter space.
scientific_limitations: For the half-diagonal two-coset lattice in its given coordinate frame only; unindexed prior equivalent statements may exist; independent full-text comparison of three potentially relevant papers was access-limited. Finite checks are supplementary to proof.
title: Sharp norm rigidity of nearest-site cells of the body-centered lattice
